description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'Sass' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Startup'. The class extends a system engine controller and contains methods related to compiling SCSS files into CSS for the admin interface of OpenCart, including checking for existing compiled files and generating them if needed.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: A controller class responsible for compiling SCSS files into CSS for the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Scans the stylesheet directory for SCSS files, compiles them into CSS if necessary, and writes the output to the corresponding CSS files. Handles caching and re-compilation based on the existence of CSS files and configuration settings.
